'''Wild Tuskbeast''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|Wild tuskbeasts are predators of the Talosian wilderness. Given the hostile environments of Talos-II, getting to the top of the food chain is no small feat.}}

==Overview==
As the only docile wildlife creature, Wild Tuskbeasts serve no purposes in combat, as they either run or howl.

They are, however, a main source of {{I|Fillet|g=0}}, which make hunting them a task when crafting Tacticals.
